messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 1.3.6

1.3.6. Risks related to variations in operating conditions Where the machinery or related product performs operations under different conditions of use, it shall be designed and constructed in such a way that selection and adjustment of these conditions can be carried out safely and reliably.

response.text:
machinery or related product | shallBeDesignedAndConstructed | so that selection and adjustment of operating conditions can be carried out safely and reliably | where it performs operations under different conditions of use | it shall be designed and constructed in such a way that selection and adjustment of these conditions can be carried out safely and reliably
selection and adjustment of operating conditions | shallBeCarriedOutSafely | safely | where the machinery performs operations under different conditions of use | selection and adjustment of these conditions can be carried out safely and reliably
selection and adjustment of operating conditions | shallBeCarriedOutReliably | reliably | where the machinery performs operations under different conditions of use | selection and adjustment of these conditions can be carried out safely and reliably
